universal.circadian.title: Your 24-Hour Cycle
universal.circadian.body: Testosterone peaks between 5:30-8:00 AM and drops 20-43% by evening. This affects your energy, mood, and performance throughout the day.
universal.peak.title: Morning Performance Window
universal.peak.body: Your peak testosterone window is in the morning. Strength, focus, and confidence are naturally highest during this time.
universal.sleep.title: Sleep Drives Hormones
universal.sleep.body: Testosterone production requires at least 3 hours of uninterrupted sleep. Poor sleep can reduce levels by 10-15%.
universal.exercise.title: Training Timing Matters
universal.exercise.body: Morning resistance training during your peak phase may amplify the natural testosterone surge.
universal.stress.title: Cortisol vs Testosterone
universal.stress.body: Chronic stress elevates cortisol which suppresses testosterone. Managing stress directly impacts your hormonal balance.
universal.seasonal.title: Seasonal Rhythms
universal.seasonal.body: Testosterone levels peak in late summer/autumn and are lowest in winter/spring, varying up to 45% across seasons.
